limits: The installer uses synthetic files, plus data-only extraction of the official ReShade setup archive.
Launcher tests exercise settings and status against fixtures; they do not call its game-launch entry point.
Compilation and lifetime review do not exercise the neural driver, real presentation, headset image quality, or process exit with a live GPU session.
